questions.final_answer: Human Gate is implemented in src/workflows/fsasm_milestone_four.py across three activities: transition_to_needs_human_activity (465-535) durably sets run+task to NEEDS_HUMAN and logs human_gate_invoked BEFORE waiting; validate_and_apply_human_decision_activity (595-796) validates task_id match, status gates, applies RETRY_ONCE (NEEDS_HUMAN->READY+RUNNING, max_attempts=attempt+1) or ABORT (->FAILED), persists state+plan and audit evidence; receive_human_decision (964-975) is the signal handler that stores the decision for later application. Durability comes from save_run_state/save_plan/save_run_log_entry before wait_condition.

Budget is controlled by ChildTask.can_retry() in src/fsasm/models.py:428-435 (attempt < max_attempts). retry_count_remaining (437-439) reports the remainder. Enforcement lives in transition_task (src/fsasm/transitions.py:132-160): for FAILED->READY it raises RetryExhaustedError if !can_retry; for FAILED->NEEDS_HUMAN it requires can_retry() to be False. Workflow surface: check_retry_budget_activity (fsasm_milestone_four.py:348-377).

Three mutation paths: (1) set_task_max_attempts_activity (fsasm_milestone_four.py:321-341) sets max_attempts = max_retries_per_task+1 authoritatively at start. (2) apply_human_authorized_task_transition (transitions.py:218-277) writes task.max_attempts = new_max_attempts on RETRY_ONCE. (3) invoked from validate_and_apply_human_decision_activity (fsasm_milestone_four.py:595-796) with new_max_attempts=task.attempt+1. Field defined in ChildTask (models.py).

questions.final_answer: Two tests in tests/test_fsasm_milestone_four.py: TestStatePersistence.test_validate_and_apply_human_decision_retry_once (559-630) unit-tests the activity for RETRY_ONCE; TestRetryOnceRegressionWorker.test_retry_once_authorizes_exactly_one_additional_execution (1704-1909) is the worker regression proving max_attempts=1 -> gate#1 -> RETRY_ONCE -> attempt 2 fails -> gate#2 (no third attempt without another signal).

questions.final_answer: persist_initial_state_activity (fsasm_milestone_four.py:252-314) creates RunState with PLANNED. The actual PLANNED->RUNNING transition happens in prepare_task_activity (src/fsasm/executor_activities.py:272-334): if state.status==PLANNED it calls transition_run(state, RunStatus.RUNNING), then transitions the task to RUNNING and persists. transition_run (transitions.py:164-210) enforces _RUN_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS which allows PLANNED->{RUNNING}.

questions.final_answer: Code: validate_and_apply_human_decision_activity persists EvidenceRecord(kind=human_gate_audit) at two sites in fsasm_milestone_four.py (694 RETRY_ONCE, 759 ABORT) with evidence_id=f"evidence-human-gate-{retry|abort}-{run_id}-{task_id}". save_evidence (persistence.py:252-265) atomically writes {evidence_id}.json. The id lacks a gate/attempt sequence so repeated RETRY_ONCE on the same run/task would overwrite. Tests: the worker regression (test_fsasm_milestone_four.py:1884-1909) asserts 2 human_gate_audit entries (1 RETRY_ONCE + 1 ABORT).
